title: FBI Photo A003
sensor_system_note: A-series — different sensor system from B-series. Small '+' reticle with horizontal tick row, NO timestamp visible, '5' scale mark only. A001-A006 are aerial terrain views (sensor pointed down at ground). A007 is the polarity-anomaly frame (sky background, bright specular target). A008 is sky background with normal dark-on-light polarity. Treat as adjacent-not-paired with B-series.

pages.image_type: black-and-white thermal or infrared targeting display with reticle overlay
pages.description: A grayscale image resembling a thermal or infrared gunsight/targeting view showing a mottled terrain-like background in shades of gray. A crosshair reticle is centered on the frame with a vertical line marked by tick marks running top to bottom and a horizontal line marked with tick marks running left to right, meeting at a central dark circular dot. Multiple solid black rectangular bars (resembling redaction blocks) are placed along the top, left, right, and bottom edges of the image, partially covering the scene. The number '5' is faintly visible along the horizontal axis to the right of center.

observations.claim: A crosshair reticle with tick marks is centered in the frame
A dark circular dot appears at the intersection of the crosshair lines
Multiple solid black rectangular bars are positioned along the image edges
The number 5 is visible along the horizontal axis right of center
The background shows mottled gray terrain-like texture

pages.reticle_style: small '+' reticle with horizontal tick row (numbered '5' mark on right). Does NOT match B-series large full-frame crosshair.
